discrepancies.problem: MayaRank is defined with TWO completely different value sets in Frontend
discrepancies.analysis: Frontend v1 matches Backend (Maya names), Frontend v2 uses completely different naming scheme (English proficiency levels)
discrepancies.impact: Code will have runtime confusion - which MayaRank should be used where?
discrepancies.recommendation:
1. Keep Frontend v1 as canonical (matches Backend)
2. Deprecate Frontend v2
3. Verify all code uses same version
4. Update Backend to v2 if leaderboard truly needs English levels

discrepancies.impact: Frontend cannot represent 'reviewed' progress state from Backend
discrepancies.recommendation: Add 'reviewed' status to Frontend ProgressStatusEnum to maintain parity

discrepancies.impact: Frontend cannot render 25 out of 31 exercise types that Backend supports
discrepancies.recommendation: Update Frontend ExerciseTypeEnum to include all 31 pedagogical types from Backend

discrepancies.analysis: Frontend has TWO difficulty enums - local one is incomplete
discrepancies.recommendation: Remove local DifficultyLevel from educational.types.ts, use DifficultyLevelEnum from shared constants

discrepancies.analysis: Backend has two separate notification type enums with different values
discrepancies.recommendation: Consolidate Backend notification types - determine canonical definition and deprecate duplicate

discrepancies.analysis: Backend has mission system (MissionType, MissionStatus) but Frontend doesn't know about it
possible_causes: Mission feature not yet implemented in Frontend
API returns mission data without Frontend consuming it
discrepancies.recommendation: Clarify design: Are missions user-facing? If yes, export MissionType and MissionStatus to Frontend

recommendations_summary: 1. CRITICAL: Resolve MayaRank duplication in Frontend - Choose one canonical definition
2. HIGH: Update Frontend ExerciseTypeEnum from 6 to 31 values for full Backend parity
3. HIGH: Add 'reviewed' status to ProgressStatusEnum in Frontend
4. MEDIUM: Consolidate Frontend duplicate difficulty enums (DifficultyLevel + DifficultyLevelEnum)
5. MEDIUM: Consolidate Backend duplicate notification enums (NotificationType + NotificationTypeEnum)
6. MEDIUM: Clarify mission system - export to Frontend if user-facing, hide if Backend-only
7. LOW: Remove frontend-only duplicates that can be imported from Backend (AchievementCategory, AchievementType, ProgressStatus)
8. LOW: Document which Frontend-only enums are intentional (LeaderboardType, LeaderboardTimePeriod, AchievementStatus)
